data.name: Urban Protocol
data.detailed_description:
BUILD THE CITY

Transform an empty landscape into a thriving urban center.

Zone districts, construct housing, create jobs, expand utilities, and develop the infrastructure required to support a growing population. Every new resident contributes to your economy—but also increases the complexity of governing the city.

MAINTAIN CONTROL

Growth alone is not enough.

As your city expands, you must preserve order and stability through policy decisions, public services, and administrative systems. Rising unrest, crime, or declining confidence can threaten the future of your city.

Balance prosperity with control and determine how your administration responds to emerging challenges.

SHAPE YOUR POLICIES

Unlock and implement policies that influence the development of your city.

Adjust taxation, public programs, surveillance measures, infrastructure priorities, and civic initiatives to guide population behavior and achieve your long-term objectives.

Every decision creates new opportunities—and new consequences.

MANAGE A LIVING ECONOMY

A successful administration depends on sustainable growth.

Generate revenue through a productive population, invest in expansion, and allocate resources across competing priorities. Poor planning can lead to stagnation, while strategic investment can transform districts into engines of prosperity.

DEVELOP YOUR OWN GOVERNANCE MODEL

There is no single path to success.

Create a prosperous and trusted city, build a highly efficient administrative state, or pursue a more interventionist approach to governance. Adapt your strategy as conditions change and discover the strengths and weaknesses of your chosen policies.

FEATURES

  • City-building and urban planning

  • Population and workforce management

  • Economic simulation

  • Governance and policy systems

  • District-based development

  • Infrastructure expansion

  • Stability and control mechanics

  • Multiple strategic approaches

  • Single-player experience

data.short_description: Build and govern a growing city where prosperity, population growth, and social control must remain in balance. Expand districts, manage infrastructure, enact policies, and maintain stability in this city-building strategy simulation.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple integrated graphics
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 15 Sequoia
  • Processor: Apple M2 or newer
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple integrated graphics
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
